"SNAPPY STRONG"
Day: 28 Monday 10-28-24
Warm Up: Make up your mind and tell yourself that you're gonna move the weights fast and SNAPPY today.
1. a. Snappy BACK Squat 5 sets of 2 reps @ 70%
super set b. Slow Strict Chin Ups 5 sets of 3-6 reps
2 min rest between each superset
2. a. BENCH PRESS 5 sets of 3 reps @ 70%
"Be Snappy"
super set b. 1-Arm DB Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
2 min rest between each superset
Cardio
a. EZ Bar or BB Skullcrushers 3x 15 reps
super set b. KB Swings 3x 10 reps
60 sec rest between each superset
Recovery
Meatloaf
Green Beans
Mac & Cheese
30 min Walk
Heavy Sleep
*This session should take 30-35 minutes
